# Contextual knowledge (published items and exceptions) (contextual-knowledge v1.0.0) — schema capability diagnostics

For each canonical rule, whether OWL, SHACL, and Neo4j enforce it natively, how it degrades where they don't, and what compensates. The canonical semantic model remains authoritative; this report makes constraint loss visible rather than silently weakening governance.
